_description: New Customer Welcome Kit — offer defaults, component list, messaging templates

first_visit_discount.exclude: Cannot be combined with other offers

what_to_expect_bullets: A thorough multi-point inspection with every service — no charge.
A written estimate before any work begins. No surprise charges.
Text or call updates when your vehicle is ready.
A 12-month / 12,000-mile warranty on parts and labor (where applicable).
Transparent pricing — we'll show you the parts we used.

tone_guidelines.voice: Warm, local, trustworthy — like a neighbor who happens to know cars.

letter_structure: Thank them for choosing the shop
One sentence on what makes the shop different
Close with invitation to call anytime
Sign-off with shop name and phone

follow_up_timing.message: Check in, ask if everything is running well, remind them of the referral offer

welcome_letter_opening:
Hi Sarah,

Welcome to the Lakewood Auto Care family! We're so glad you chose us for your first visit, and we truly mean it when we say — this is the beginning of a long, reliable relationship.

At Lakewood Auto Care, we believe you deserve to understand exactly what's happening with your vehicle and why. No pressure, no surprises. Just honest work from a team that cares.

Dear Marcus,

Thank you for giving Peak Auto the chance to earn your trust. Whether you came in for something small or you've got bigger concerns about your vehicle, we're here to help you take care of it — on your timeline and your budget.

Owner-operated since 2009, we treat every car like it belongs to a family member.

Hi Dana,

Welcome! We're a small shop, and that means a lot to us — every new customer matters. Thank you for choosing South Side Auto for your vehicle care needs.

Here's what you can always expect from us: a straight answer, a fair price, and a call before we do anything you didn't ask for.
what_makes_us_different: We're not a chain. When you bring your car to us, you'll work with the same advisors and technicians every time. We'll learn your car, and we'll learn your preferences.
We explain things in plain English — no tech jargon, no pressure tactics. You'll always know what we found, why it matters, and what it'll cost before we touch anything.
Every service includes a free multi-point inspection. We'll tell you what we see — the good and the not-so-good — and let you decide what to do with that information.
